messages:
laura: quick heads-up — my docs PR (#4567) preview failed ci lints (mdlint + spellcheck + vale). linkcheck is green though. planning to merge in today’s docs slot if we can get a quick fix and a reviewer. pinging @ben @sam.
ci-bot: preview build failed — md-lint MD013(line-length), MD041(first-line-heading), spellcheck: 'teh' in docs/migration/upgrade.md, vale: PassiveVoice in docs/guides/async-calls.md. full logs: https://ci.example/preview/4567
ben: can take a look in ~20m. probably a mix of long lines and one automated spell false positive. if vale is complaining we can either rewrite the sentence or add a vale exception for that file.
sam: I can review after ben's patch. if it's tiny we can merge during the 4pm slot.
laura: ideal is a tiny patch (shorten lines + fix spelling). ben — if you want me to cut it down instead I can open a follow-up. don't want to block other docs changes.
ben: I'll open a patch branch off laura's PR with fixes. plan: run mdformat and a quick spellcheck, and reflow long paragraphs.
ben: quick commands I run locally:
```
# reflow long lines to 100 chars
python - <<'PY'
import textwrap,sys
p='docs/migration/upgrade.md'
t=open(p).read()
open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(textwrap.fill(l,100) for l in t.splitlines()))
PY
# then run `pre-commit run --all-files` and push
```
laura: nice — thanks. one vale instance is intentional phrasing (passive voice for audit sentence). should we add a comment to suppress just that rule instead of rewriting? avoids changing legal phrasing.
tess: fyi I'm OOO until 3pm but can approve after that if everything passes CI.
ben: put a local vale override comment in that paragraph and add a short note in the PR description explaining the rationale. fixed spelling for 'teh' and wrapped lines in 3 files. pushed as ben/fix/docs-lint-4567.
ci-bot: triggered preview for ben/fix/docs-lint-4567 — build 7890 queued.
ci-bot: preview build 7890 completed — lint stage passed, preview site built at https://preview.docs.example/branches/ben/fix/docs-lint-4567
sam: checked the preview, looks good. tiny wording note in async-calls.md but not lint-blocking. approving now.
doc-bot: laura requested merge in todays docs slot; approval count 1/1, waiting required hold time (5m) before merging.
laura: merging after the hold. thanks everyone :tada:
ci-bot: merged ben/fix/docs-lint-4567 into main (auto-merge after hold). release pipeline will pick it up.
laura: verified site after merge — no more md-lint or vale alerts. closing the thread. thanks all :raised_hands:
__notes: thread about docs preview failures and short fix + reviewer coordination
